tagline.en: Tencent Hunyuan's world model for panorama generation and 3D scene reconstruction.
tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的世界模型，用于全景生成与三维场景重建。

en: HY-World 2.0 is Tencent Hunyuan's world model, aimed at generating and reconstructing 3D worlds. WorldFoundry brings it in through two components: HY-Pano 2.0 for panorama generation and WorldMirror 2.0 for scene reconstruction.

The reconstruction path takes input views and exports a rich set of 3D artifacts — depth, normals, a point cloud, a Gaussian splat, camera parameters, and COLMAP sparse files — along with scene metadata, so you get geometry you can inspect and reuse. Upstream, the family targets text-, image-, and video-to-3D-world generation and simulation.
In WorldFoundry you run HY-World 2.0 through its pipeline for panorama and reconstruction workflows; feed it images and it writes out the reconstructed scene and its 3D outputs.
zh: HY-World 2.0 是腾讯混元的世界模型，目标是生成与重建三维世界。WorldFoundry 通过两个组件接入它：用于全景生成的 HY-Pano 2.0，以及用于场景重建的 WorldMirror 2.0。
重建路径接收输入视角，导出一整套三维产物——深度、法线、点云、Gaussian splat、相机参数与 COLMAP 稀疏文件——并附带场景元数据，让你得到可查看、可复用的几何。在上游，该家族面向文本、图像、视频到三维世界的生成与仿真。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过它的 pipeline 运行 HY-World 2.0 来完成全景与重建工作流；输入图像，它便输出重建出的场景及其三维产物。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to reconstruct a 3D scene from images and export usable geometry — depth, normals, point clouds, Gaussian splats, and camera/COLMAP files — or generate panoramas within a world-model pipeline.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图像重建三维场景并导出可用几何——深度、法线、点云、Gaussian splat 以及相机/COLMAP 文件——或在世界模型 pipeline 中生成全景时使用。

notFor.en: In WorldFoundry the reconstruction and panorama paths are the exposed workflows; a full end-to-end text/image-to-3D-world generation route is still being brought over from upstream.
notFor.zh: 在 WorldFoundry 中，重建与全景路径是当前开放的工作流；完整的端到端文本/图像到三维世界生成路径仍在从上游迁移中。
